note: USB beat as an object you inspect. Ends map to v1 ids: usb-plug, usb-it, usb-leave. Plugging it in schedules the printer glitch and IT's call later in the shift.

find.say: A USB stick on the hot desk. Handwritten label: Salary review. An open laptop sits right next to it.

it.say: Don't plug it in. Bag it and drop it at the security desk on your way out. We'll pick it up. Good call asking.

look_label.label: Look at the label
look_label.look: Black marker: SALARY REVIEW · Q4. No asset tag, no IT sticker. Nobody's name.

look_laptop.label: Look at the laptop
look_laptop.look: The loaner is unlocked and signed in. Whatever you plug in here runs as whoever's signed in.

plug.label: Plug it in to see whose it is

tells.why: "Salary review" is bait. The label is written to make you curious enough to look.
An unlocked laptop right next to it. One plug-in and it runs as that person.
You asked IT before touching it. That's the habit.

headlines.usb-leave: You left it. The next person might not.
headlines.usb-plug: You plugged in a stranger's USB.
